name: app.lingard/vocab
title: Lingard Vocab
description: Build and enrich your Lingard vocabulary: topic collections, flashcards, translations, examples.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the user's live Lingard account: vocabulary, learning context, English profile, totals, collection titles, saved words, flashcards, and missing vocabulary fields. Results are read from Firestore at the time of the call.

query.description: Search query, for example "English learning context" or "saved vocabulary collections".

targetLang.description: Lingard target language code such as en, de, es, fr, it, pl, or pt. Defaults to en when the prompt asks about English.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches the full live Lingard JSON record for a search-result id (e.g. "learning-context:en") or a Lingard resource URI such as lingard://learning-context/en.

inputSchema.description: The record is identified by exactly one of `id` or `uri`. If both are sent, `id` is used. If neither is sent, `targetLang` selects that language's learning context.

id.description: Preferred selector: a search-result id, e.g. "learning-context:en". Takes `id` OR `uri` (not both); if both are given, `id` wins.

uri.description: Alternative selector, used only when `id` is omitted: a Lingard resource URI, e.g. "lingard://learning-context/en".

targetLang.description: Fallback used only when neither `id` nor `uri` is provided: a language code (en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt) whose learning context to fetch.

tools.name: lingard_get_learning_context
tools.description: Returns the user's current Lingard learning context, read live from their account: English profile, vocabulary totals, saved collections and their titles, card counts, and missing-field stats. Earlier answers in the conversation may be out of date; this is the account as it stands now. The list covers every collection the account has, so the per-collection counts add up to the card total (totals.truncated marks a library too large to list in full). Every collection reports `source`: "user" (made by the user), "catalog" (a curated Lingard collection — read-only, its words come from the Lingard catalog) and "unfiled" (the bucket of cards saved while reading, which belong to no collection). Catalog and unfiled entries carry titles the user did not choose; they belong to the same account all the same.

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.

tools.name: lingard_get_vocab_collection
tools.description: Returns live cards from one Lingard vocabulary collection by UUID or title, including curated Lingard collections and the "Words not in a collection" bucket of cards saved while reading. With includeExamples:true it also returns each card's example sentences and their translations, which editing examples starts from.

inputSchema.description: Identify the collection with `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` (provide one; UUID wins if both are given).

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.

collectionUuid.description: Collection selector (preferred): its UUID. One of `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` is required.

collectionTitle.description: Collection selector (alternative to `collectionUuid`): the collection title.

limit.description: Optional max number of cards to return (1–1000).

includeExamples.description: Default false. True returns the full example rows (`examples`: example text, translation line, enabled flag) for every card instead of just the `exampleCount`.

tools.name: lingard_get_collection_gaps
tools.description: Returns live Lingard cards in a collection that are missing requested fields such as translation, POS, pronunciation, examples, or image. A curated Lingard collection always reports zero gaps: its words come from the Lingard catalog and are not the user's to fill.

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.

collectionUuid.description: Collection selector (preferred): its UUID. One of `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` is required (UUID wins if both are given).

collectionTitle.description: Collection selector (alternative to `collectionUuid`): the collection title.

fields.description: Optional. An ARRAY of field-name strings, not a bare string: e.g. ["translation"] for one field or ["translation","image"] for several. Returns cards missing ANY listed field; without it every field is checked.

limit.description: Optional max number of cards to return (1–1000, default 200).

tools.name: lingard_get_word_suggestion_context
tools.description: Returns live Lingard profile level, topic, collection context, and the words the user already has: the context for suggesting level-appropriate new cards that are not duplicates.

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.

topic.description: Optional topic of the new words, e.g. "airport" or "cooking". Defaults to the title of the selected collection.

level.description: Optional level of the new words, e.g. A2 or B1. Defaults to the level in the user's Lingard profile.

count.description: How many new words are planned (1–100, default 20); returned as guidance.generateExactly.

collectionUuid.description: Optional collection the new words are meant for, by UUID (wins over `collectionTitle`). The result says whether it accepts new cards.

collectionTitle.description: Optional collection the new words are meant for, by title (alternative to `collectionUuid`).

excludeLimit.description: Max number of the user's existing words returned for deduplication (100–5000, default 1000); exclusions.truncated marks a longer list.

tools.name: lingard_preview_vocab_changes
tools.description: Previews a Lingard vocabulary collection/card change without writing to Firestore. Cards are checked as on commit. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card needs title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, and examples with translations; image is optional. A German or Romance noun title carries its dictionary article when one is used, e.g. der Hund, die Reise, das Haus. In example text and example translation the target word and the translated word are marked with {}. form is not part of speech: it holds the inflected-form category of the current word and stays empty for base forms.

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.
Language code, as at the top level; the top-level `targetLang` wins when both are given.

collectionUuid.description: UUID of the collection to change. One of `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` names the collection (UUID wins if both are given).

collectionTitle.description: Title of the collection to change, or of the collection to create when none matches.

topic.description: Topic of a collection this change creates; defaults to its title. Stands in for the title when neither collectionTitle nor title is given.

color.description: Optional Lingard collection color. Accepts Swift raw hex like ff9500 or names like orange.

pic.description: Optional Lingard standard collection icon raw value, for example collection.plane or plane.

mergeMode.description: What happens to a word that is already in the collection: "fill_missing" (default) fills only its empty fields, "overwrite_non_empty" replaces filled-in values with the ones sent, "add_only" leaves it unchanged.

createIfMissing.description: Default true: a collection that matches neither the UUID nor the title is created. False returns a "Collection not found" error instead.

allowIncompleteCards.description: Default false. True marks the change as a sparse or exact import that the user asked for; it lets cards through without the complete-card fields (title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, examples with translations, the dictionary article on a German/Romance noun title, {} highlights in examples). form is needed only when the current word is an inflected form.

cards.description: Cards to add to the collection or merge into its existing cards, matched by normalized word title.

items.description: Lingard vocabulary card. A complete card has title/word, translate/translation, pos, pron or ipa, syns/synonyms, and examples with translations; image is optional. German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Portuguese noun titles carry their dictionary article when one is used, e.g. German: der Hund, die Reise, das Haus; pron/ipa never includes the article. In every example the target word is wrapped in {}, and in the example translation the translated word is wrapped in {}. form holds the current inflected-form category and is empty for base forms.

title.description: Word or phrase in the target language. A noun in a language with grammatical gender carries its dictionary article when one is used, e.g. German der Hund / die Reise / das Haus, Spanish el aeropuerto / la ciudad, French le livre / la maison.

word.description: Alias for title; a German/Romance noun carries its article here too.

translate.description: Translation into the user native language.

pos.description: Part of speech, for example noun, verb, adjective, adverb, phrase.

pron.description: Pronunciation or IPA transcription (for English: IPA or a clear phonetic transcription).

form.description: Current inflected-form category, not part of speech. English values: past, present participle, past participle, 3rd sg. present, plural, comparative, superlative. A base/unmarked form, singular noun, phrase, or word with no category has no form (field omitted or null).

syns.description: Synonyms or close alternatives in the target language; a complete card has at least one.

examples.description: Example sentences or collocations with translations, as objects with c/collocate/example and t/translate/translation. The target word in the example and the translated word in the translation are wrapped in {}, for example c:"I missed my {flight}.", t:"Я опоздал на свой {рейс}.". A translation is required; t:"" (or null) stores the example with an empty translation line, for examples the user wants untranslated.

c.description: Example sentence or collocation in the target language, with the target word wrapped in {}, e.g. "I missed my {flight}."

t.description: Translation line. Empty string or null stores the example without a translation.

e.description: Whether the example is enabled on the card. Default true.

clearFields.description: ["form"] clears an existing incorrect grammatical form when the current word is base/unmarked. Only form is supported.

allowMissingArticle.description: True for proper nouns, fixed terms, or exceptional nouns that are used without a dictionary article.

tools.name: lingard_commit_vocab_changes
tools.description: Commits a previously previewed or freshly supplied Lingard vocabulary change. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card needs title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, and examples with translations; image is optional. A German or Romance noun title carries its dictionary article when one is used, e.g. der Hund, die Reise, das Haus. tools.name: lingard_add_words_to_collection
tools.description: Adds cards to an existing Lingard collection, deduplicating by normalized word title; commit=true writes them. Only collections with writable="full" accept new cards: curated Lingard collections are read-only and the unfiled bucket takes no new cards. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card needs title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, and examples with translations; image is optional. A German or Romance noun title carries its dictionary article when one is used, e.g. der Hund, die Reise, das Haus. In example text and example translation the target word and the translated word are marked with {}. form is not part of speech: it holds the inflected-form category of the current word and stays empty for base forms. It only adds: a word already in the collection gets its empty fields filled (mergeMode "fill_missing", the default) or is left alone ("add_only"); a value that is already filled in is never changed or cleared.

t.description: Translation line. Empty string or null stores the example without a translation.

e.description: Whether the example is enabled on the card. Default true.

allowMissingArticle.description: True for proper nouns, fixed terms, or exceptional nouns that are used without a dictionary article.

commit.description: True writes. Default false returns a preview of the result without writing.

tools.name: lingard_update_example_translations
tools.description: Rewrites only the translation line of examples that already exist on Lingard cards; the example sentence, its {} highlights and its audio/typing markers are left exactly as they are. It changes, adds, or removes example translations; an empty translation is a supported card state, not an error. `translations` holds one entry per existing example, in order, so it is built from the card's current examples (a collection read with includeExamples:true lists them). commit=true writes; without it the call returns the resulting examples as a preview.

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.

collectionUuid.description: Optional default collection for cards addressed by title.

collectionTitle.description: Optional default collection title for cards addressed by title.

cards.description: One entry per card to edit. Each entry needs a card selector (`cardId`, or `title` plus a collection when the word occurs in several) and `translations`.

cardId.description: Card selector (preferred): the card's cardId, as listed with the collection's cards.

title.description: Card selector (alternative to `cardId`): the word on the card.

collectionUuid.description: Collection of this card by UUID, for a word that occurs in several collections; overrides the top-level default.

collectionTitle.description: Collection of this card by title (alternative to `collectionUuid`).

translations.description: Positional: entry N replaces the translation line of example N, and a shorter list leaves the remaining examples untouched. Use "" or null to leave an example untranslated (this is allowed and is how a user clears a translation), or {"index":2,"t":"…"} to patch a single example. The example text itself is never read from here.

index.description: Position of the example on the card, counting from 0.

t.description: New translation line; "" or null leaves the example untranslated.

commit.description: True writes. Default false returns the resulting examples without saving.

tools.name: lingard_attach_card_images
tools.description: Attaches supplied images to existing Lingard cards. It does not generate images: each entry carries the image itself as imageBase64 or dataUri, or an imageUrl that the server downloads. PNG, JPEG, WebP, and SVG inputs are converted to WebP and uploaded as private custom card images; an image the card already has is replaced. commit=true writes.

targetLang.description: The language the user is learning, as a Lingard language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, it, pl, pt.

collectionUuid.description: Optional default collection (by UUID) for cards addressed by title.

collectionTitle.description: Optional default collection title for cards addressed by title.

images.description: One entry per card to illustrate. Each entry needs a card selector (`cardId` or `title`) and exactly one image source (`imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`).

items.description: One image to attach to one card: a card selector (`cardId` or `title`) and exactly one image source (`imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). Every other field is optional.

cardId.description: Card selector (preferred): UUID of the card to attach the image to. One of `cardId` or `title` is required.

title.description: Card selector (alternative to `cardId`): the card's word/title. One of `cardId` or `title` is required.

collectionUuid.description: Optional: limit the card lookup to this collection UUID (disambiguates a `title`).

collectionTitle.description: Optional: limit the card lookup to this collection by title.

imageBase64.description: Image source (an entry carries EXACTLY ONE of `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). Base64 image bytes (PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG; converted to WebP).

dataUri.description: Image source (an entry carries EXACTLY ONE of `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). Data URI, e.g. data:image/webp;base64,... or data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg...>.

imageUrl.description: Image source (an entry carries EXACTLY ONE of `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`). HTTP(S) URL to fetch and convert.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME-type hint for `imageBase64`, e.g. image/png; the server also sniffs the decoded header.

prompt.description: Not supported: this tool cannot create an image from a prompt; it needs `imageBase64`, `dataUri`, or `imageUrl`.

commit.description: True uploads and attaches. Default false returns a dry-run preview without writing.

tools.name: lingard_get_learning_pauses
tools.description: Lists, for one language, the user's collections and sources (books, the news) and which of them are on pause. A collection or source on pause gives the automatic «Now learning» sessions no words — no new words and no reviews — and is not counted in the day's goals or reminders; opening it in the app still studies it as usual. Each entry carries the exact uuid, bookKey, and title that pause changes take.

targetLang.description: The learned language, e.g. en, de, es, fr.

tools.name: lingard_set_learning_pauses
tools.description: Puts collections and sources on pause or takes them off it, for one language — e.g. "study only my Travel collection this week", "pause the news words", "resume everything". action: "pause" or "resume" the listed ones; "only" — resume the listed ones and pause every other collection and source of the language; "resume_all" — take every pause off (lists ignored). Collections are named by uuid or exact title and sources by bookKey or exact title, as the learning-pause list reports them. A paused item gives the automatic «Now learning» sessions no words and is not counted in goals or reminders; opening it in the app still studies it. commit=true writes; without it the call returns a preview of the changes and the resulting state.

targetLang.description: The learned language, e.g. en, de, es, fr.

action.description: "pause" or "resume" the listed collections and sources; "only" resumes the listed ones and pauses every other one of the language; "resume_all" takes every pause off and ignores the lists.

collections.description: Collections by uuid or exact title.

sources.description: Sources by bookKey (catalog:… / imported:…) or exact title.

commit.description: True writes. Default false returns a preview without writing.
